rent_threshold.label: Rent Payment Reporting Threshold
rent_threshold.description: Report rent payments of $600 or more in box 1. This includes payments for office space, machinery, equipment, or other rental property. Rent does not include payments to employees for business travel expenses.

royalty_threshold.label: Royalty Payment Reporting Threshold
royalty_threshold.description: Report royalty payments of $10 or more in box 2. This includes payments for oil, gas, or mineral properties, and copyrights and patents. For oil and gas payments, also report in box 7 if there is no active trade or business.
validationRules: Lower threshold than other payment types
Distinguish between with and without business activity

other_income_threshold.label: Other Income Reporting Threshold
other_income_threshold.description: Report other income payments of $600 or more in box 3. This includes prizes, awards, jury duty pay, and other income not specified elsewhere. Payments to attorneys for legal services may also be reported here.
validationRules: Use for payments not covered by other boxes

box7_requirements.label: Box 7 - Direct Sales Requirements
box7_requirements.description: Report gross amount paid to a recipient in box 7 if the payment is for direct sales of consumer products for resale anywhere other than a permanent retail establishment. This applies to direct sales network arrangements.
validationRules: Only for direct sales of consumer products
Sales not through permanent retail establishment

backup_withholding.label: Backup Withholding Rate
backup_withholding.description: If a payee did not provide a TIN or the IRS notified you that the payee's TIN is incorrect, you must withhold backup withholding. The rate is currently 24% of the payment amount. Report the total amount of backup withholding in box 4.
validationRules: Apply when TIN is missing or incorrect
